title: In the history of horse racing, few horses have captured the…

sents.en: In the history of horse racing, few horses have captured the affection of the British public like Red Rum.
sents.cn: 在赛马史上，很少有马能像RedRum那样俘获英国公众的喜爱。

sents.en: Today, three decades after his retirement, he is still one of the best-known and most beloved racehorses of all time.
sents.cn: 如今在他退役三十年后，他仍是有史以来最知名、最受爱戴的赛马之一。

sents.en: Red Rum was passed around to several owners before being purchased for Noel Le Mar.
sents.cn: 在被买给诺埃尔∙勒马尔之前，RedRum几经转手、换过几位主人。

sents.en: The agent who made the purchase was the now-legendary horse trainer Donald "Ginger" McCain.
sents.cn: 促成这笔交易的经纪人，是如今已传奇化的驯马师唐纳德∙“金杰”∙麦凯恩。

sents.en: It wasn't apparent at the time, but Red Rum had a serious bone disease in his foot.
sents.cn: 当时并未显露，但RedRum的脚上患了一种严重的骨病。

sents.en: For many horses (and many trainers) this would mean the end of a racing career before it even began.
sents.cn: 对许多马（以及许多驯马师）而言，这意味著赛马生涯尚未开始便已结束。

sents.en: For Ginger and Red Rum, though, it was just an obstacle to greatness that had to be overcome.
sents.cn: 然而对金杰和RedRum来说，这不过是通往伟大之路上必须跨越的一道障碍。

sents.en: Red Rum's true talent came out in steeplechases.
sents.cn: RedRum真正的天赋在障碍赛马中展现出来。

sents.en: His power, speed and jumping ability carried him to his first Grand National title in 1973.
sents.cn: 他的力量、速度和弹跳能力助他在1973年夺得首个全国大赛（GrandNational）冠军。

sents.en: The very next year, Red Rum returned to take his second title.
sents.cn: 紧接着次年，RedRum重返赛场，拿下第二个冠军。

sents.en: He was the first horse to take successive firsts since Reynoldstown in 1935-1936.
sents.cn: 他是自1935—1936年Reynoldstown之后首匹蝉联冠军的赛马。

sents.en: Red Rum's spirit and grace had already begun to charm the leagues of Grand National fans.
sents.cn: RedRum的精神与优雅，早已开始迷住大批全国大赛的粉丝。

sents.en: In the following two years, Red Rum lost out on the title, coming in second both times.
sents.cn: 随后的两年里，RedRum与冠军失之交臂，两次都位居第二。

sents.en: When he returned in 1977 to try again, he was largely regarded as past his prime.
sents.cn: 1977年他再度归来挑战时，很大程度上被认为已过了巅峰。

sents.en: He was 12 years old and not expected to place highly.
sents.cn: 他当时12岁，没人指望他能取得好名次。

sents.en: He surprised sporting fans around the world when he came in a remarkable 25 lengths ahead of the nearest horse, taking his third Grand National win.
sents.cn: 然而当他又一次以领先最近的对手多达25个马位的惊人成绩冲线、拿下第三个全国大赛冠军时，全世界的体育迷都为之震惊。

sents.en: To this day, Red Rum's third win is known as one of the greatest moments in horse racing history.
sents.cn: 时至今日，RedRum的第三次夺冠仍被视为赛马史上最伟大的时刻之一。

sents.en: Red Rum was headed for the Grand National once again in 1978 but suffered an injury in one of his heels shortly before the race.
sents.cn: 1978年，RedRum再度向全国大赛进发，却在比赛前不久一只脚跟受伤。

sents.en: He was retired soon after, but his public life and fame by no means decreased with the end of his career.
sents.cn: 不久他便退役，但他的公众生活与名气绝未随生涯终结而减退。

sents.en: Red Rum traveled all over the country for various engagements. He often led pre-race parades at Aintree Racecourse and was a popular guest at charity benefits and public events.
sents.cn: RedRum为各种活动走遍全国，他常在安特里赛马场领跑赛前游行，也是慈善义演和公共活动中颇受欢迎的嘉宾。
